items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: And, I'm telling you, one man just played two drums, you know. ... So, we all used to have a good time, and all used to say, well, where's Rich yet? He ain't in the band.

ctx.x: I wondered what the five were, yeah. Anyway, those are the main ones. Rex, Comus, Momus, and Proteus. That's it. So those are the big ones today.

Yeah, then I used to go out to Millen Boyd and blow the roofs off the... There's all tin roofs out there. And I'd get up there with fishing and shilling, sometime with Jacqueline. Well, shilling's different, isn't it? Yeah, shilling is still... I talked to him one day. Yeah. And we'd go out there in the morning, with white suits on, and come back with our white suits loaded with cinders. Oh, yeah. From Smokey Murray. And not only our pockets loaded with cinders, something else, too, you know. So, we all used to…

Yes, the bass drum with the flip pedal. Yeah. And, uh, we also... I was gonna ask about some of the other bands, the real old time bands. For instance, Emil Tasso's band, Spanish Fork. Did you ever hear that? Who? Tasso? Tasso. What kind of a band was that? That was Tasso, a big concert band. Did you ever play in that? No, no, no. That was all music they used there, yes. All music. Played by music. Was that a pretty big band? How big was it? About 20 men. 20 men. Yeah, sometimes more. How late did they play?…
